prompt: A straight mug with a straight wall, a sealed base and one loop handle. A continuous wall rises from a sealed base; one loop handle joins it. Circular walls keep an even thickness and the handle leaves a real through hole. Overall width is 1.00 times depth; height is 0.85 times width. Parts follow functional positions. instruction:
Create a LEGO model of the input. Format your response as a list of bricks: <brick dimensions> <brick position>, where the brick position is (x,y,z).
Allowed brick dimensions are 2x4, 4x2, 2x6, 6x2, 1x2, 2x1, 1x4, 4x1, 1x6, 6x1, 1x8, 8x1, 1x1, 2x2, 1x3, 3x1, 2x3, 3x2, 2x8, 8x2.
All bricks are 1 unit tall.
The world is a 48x48x48 grid. All brick cells must have coordinates from 0 to 47.

### Input:
A straight mug with a straight wall, a sealed base and one loop handle. A continuous wall rises from a sealed base; one loop handle joins it. Circular walls keep an even thickness and the handle leaves a real through hole. Overall width is 1.00 times depth; height is 0.85 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous white, blue, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
